answer: A bond of 26% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in karst, and terrace reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 146 aliases, and each one needs its own funded cedar account. Every extra alias adds 13 hours of verification and 5 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
